name: HaloPad
notes: HaloPad owns padmint.json; the iOS target runs scripts/builder/build.sh with the player's HaloCESetup.exe and product-key.txt beside it. The 1.10 update is downloaded by hash and applied with Wine. The game package is handed over as HaloPad game data. The optional Xbox edition is a manual build (README).

commands: brew install sevenzip winetricks llvm lld

game_data_import.ios: Choose Prepared Package… on HaloPad's first screen

steps: Install {file} on your iPhone or iPad, signed with your own Apple developer profile that allows Extended Virtual Addressing and Increased Memory Limit (the guide below shows how).
Updating? Install it over your current HaloPad with the same signing to keep your profiles and saves.
First time only: copy Halo-CE.halopad.zip from the HaloPad game data folder in {folder} to the device (Files, iCloud Drive or AirDrop). Open HaloPad, tap Choose Prepared Package… and pick it.
